name: tendril-kanban
description: Orchestrate AI coding agents across all your projects. A cross-project knowledge graph remembers your patterns and conventions so agents reuse what worked in your other repos. Runs on your choice of Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google — matching each phase (plan, build, audit, review) to the right model in that provider's lineup. Windows-native.

scripts.electron:dev: node scripts/ensure-native-abi.js --target electron && npm run build:dashboard && electron electron/main.js
scripts.electron:build: node scripts/sync-appx-version.js && npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:appx-tiles && npm run rebuild:native && npm run fetch:bundled-deps && electron-builder && npm run sign:appx && npm run prune:release
scripts.release: npm run electron:build:protected && aws s3 sync release/ s3://tendril-releases/releases/
scripts.test: npx playwright test && npx vitest run
